title: Extension frontmatter
description: The `extension:` block of site/src/content/docs/extensions/<Component>.<name>.md. Adds props, events, unlocked style bindings, copy, keyboard rules, behavior scenarios and hand-written modules to a system component; tools/parse.ts merges it into the component's schema. Prop/event/style/keyboard/behavior shapes are the component schema's own ($ref across files; tools/parse.ts validates against the Zod schema in schema/component.ts). Mirrors schema/extension.ts.

moduleDef.description: A hand-written module the generated component must import and call. Lives at packages/<platform>/src/<path>; the parser writes a .d.ts stub from `signature` and the `modules` gate typechecks the real file against it.

path.description: Relative to packages/<platform>/src/, always under custom/.

signature.description: TypeScript function type, e.g. '(name: string, label: string) => void'.

wire.description: Exactly where the component calls it, in one sentence.

platforms.description: Omit = every platform the component supports.

extends.description: The component this extends, by schema name.

name.description: The concern, kebab-case; the file is <Component>.<name>.md.

styles.description: Unlocked bindings only; the parser rejects `locked: true` and any token a contrast pair locks.
